import hashlib,json,os,re
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen,build_opener,HTTPRedirectHandler
class NoRedirect(HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self,*args,**kwargs): return None
base='https://api.github.com/repos/birdhackor/tiny-perceptron-vlm'
headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['GH_TOKEN'],'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','User-Agent':'course-ci-proof'}
def api(path):
    with urlopen(Request(base+path,headers=headers),timeout=40) as response: return json.load(response)
def log(job):
    try:
        with build_opener(NoRedirect()).open(Request(base+f'/actions/jobs/{job}/logs',headers=headers),timeout=40) as response: return response.read()
    except HTTPError as error:
        if error.code!=302: raise
        with urlopen(Request(error.headers['Location'],headers={'User-Agent':'course-ci-proof'}),timeout=60) as response: return response.read()
run=api('/actions/runs/37071683289')
assert run['head_sha']=='1ac7fcbfafca30a7ec1d46d82947a16f82fb7bbe'
assert run['status']=='completed' and run['conclusion']=='success'
jobs=api('/actions/runs/37071683289/jobs')['jobs']
assert len(jobs)==4 and all(j['status']=='completed' and j['conclusion']=='success' for j in jobs)
records=[]
for j in jobs:
    if not j['name'].startswith('test '): continue
    raw=log(j['id'])
    text=raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').replace('\r\n','\n')
    summaries=re.findall(r'[0-9]+ passed(?:, [0-9]+ skipped)? in [0-9.]+s',text)
    assert len(summaries)==1, j['name']
    environment_fields={key:value.strip() for key,value in re.findall(r'(?m)^\S+Z (python|os|torch|torch\.cuda|device|compute)\s+([^\r\n]+)$',text)}
    records.append({'environment_check':environment_fields,'job':j['name'],'job_id':j['id'],'url':j['html_url'],'summary':summaries[0],'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'successful_pytest_step':next(s['name'] for s in j['steps'] if 'pytest' in s['name'] and s['conclusion']=='success')})
assert len(records)==3
proof={'schema_version':1,'checked_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Actual completed GitHub CI at the fixed repair commit: lint and CPU-oriented test suites on Windows, Linux and macOS. This is release-control and repository testing, not independent lesson reviews, full model training, or a remote Colab run. The environment check records its actual chosen device; when MPS is present it performs only a 256x256 matrix forward/backward and a 32x32 CPU comparison, not the full course on MPS. Signed log redirects were read without forwarding the GitHub Authorization header.','run_id':run['id'],'url':run['html_url'],'revision':run['head_sha'],'status':run['conclusion'],'jobs':records,'verification_program_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'verification_program':Path(__file__).read_text(),'source_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ('scripts/modal_course.py','scripts/release_course_batch.py','tests/test_modal_course_contract.py','tests/test_release_course_batch.py','scripts/check_env.py','tests/test_env.py')}}
p=Path('docs/validation-artifacts/release-compatibility-ci.json')
p.write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'run_id':run['id'],'status':proof['status'],'actual_test_summaries':records}))
